LightfallSword.label: Lightfall Sword at 30 stacks
LightfallSword.reason: The sword gains a stack from her own Normal Attacks, Skill and Burst while it is up, so how many it holds depends on how many hits she lands; 30 is the most. Checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer.

Grimheart.label: Grimheart stacks
Grimheart.reason: Stacks of her Skill that raise DEF, which none of her counted hits use.

TidalIllusion.label: Constellation 1 Physical bonus
TidalIllusion.reason: Her held Skill spends her Grimheart stacks before her Burst, and the bonus lasts long enough to cover her attacks and the Lightfall Sword.
